nodes.label: SmartKanban macOS App Plan
nodes.rationale: Master build plan for a native macOS client mirroring the React/Fastify web app; produced by a 7-agent specialist pipeline. Confidence 8/10, 0 reviewer vetoes.

nodes.label: 7-Agent Specialist Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Analyst → PM → Designer → Architect → Engineer → QA → Reviewer sequence that authored the plan; sections are attributed to stages (S2, S4, S5, S7).

nodes.label: SwiftUI + AppKit Interop Stack
nodes.rationale: Locked stack: Swift 5.10, Xcode 15.4+, macOS 13.3 Ventura+ target, arm64. SwiftUI primary with AppKit interop (NSWindow/NSMenu/NSToolbar/NSStatusBar) where SwiftUI APIs are incomplete pre-14. Single ~25MB binary, low memory, native Keychain + URLSessionWebSocketTask, no third-party deps.

nodes.label: Tauri 2 Rejection
nodes.rationale: Rejected: would just shell the existing React app, WKWebView CSS quirks break dnd-kit/Tailwind, no native NSMenu, sandboxed WebView blocks native paste/drag, adds a Rust toolchain, 30-40MB binary.

nodes.label: Electron Rejection
nodes.rationale: Rejected: 80-150MB Chromium binary, ~300MB idle memory, poor menu hot-reload with React, worse battery on M-series, extra build tooling.

nodes.label: MVP / V1 / V2 Release Scope
nodes.rationale: 735 registry rows dispositioned: ~280 rows MVP (auth, board+DnD, edit, AI insights, timeline, knowledge, notifications, capture, settings, WS sync), V1 adds templates CRUD/card chain/weather/ticker, V2 adds mirror kiosk/Spotlight/share extension, ~125 rows out-of-scope.

nodes.label: R-001 macOS 13.3 SwiftUI Gaps
nodes.rationale: HIGH risk: NavigationSplitView, programmatic window opening, NSDraggable-in-List flaky pre-14. Mitigated via NSViewRepresentable / NSWindowController interop and AppKit-backed List with explicit ids.

nodes.label: R-002 Web Push VAPID Bridge
nodes.rationale: MED risk: native macOS apps cannot consume VAPID web-push. LOCKED option (b) for MVP: in-app WebSocket events drive local UNUserNotificationCenter banners, no server changes; APNs second channel deferred to V1.

nodes.label: R-003 Unsigned DMG Distribution
nodes.rationale: MED risk: no Developer ID cert means every install needs `xattr -cr /Applications/KanbanClaude.app`. Mitigated with installer script + DMG license slide; $99/yr Developer ID + notarization deferred to V2.

nodes.label: kanbanclaude:// URL Scheme
nodes.rationale: Bundle ID com.kanbanclaude.kanbanclaude, binary KanbanClaude / display SmartKanban. URL scheme used for deep links and (per admin plan) the OAuth ticket handoff.

nodes.label: Rule 2 Verbatim Codable Mirroring
nodes.rationale: macOS Codables mirror the server envelope shapes verbatim from cards.ts / types.ts / schema.sql; snake_case JSON mapped to camelCase via CodingKeys; no nesting 'for cleanliness'.

nodes.label: Card Visibility Predicate
nodes.rationale: A card is visible iff created_by==U OR U in assignees OR U in shares OR assignees empty (Family Inbox). The macOS WS reconciler must reproduce this client-side for optimistic UI.

nodes.label: Fractional Position Drag Math
nodes.rationale: New card = MIN(position)-1; drag computes midpoint between neighbors. Signed Doubles, no server rebalance. A DragController actor replaces @dnd-kit using NSItemProvider + onDrag/onDrop.

nodes.label: WebSocket Optimistic Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: URLSessionWebSocketTask feeds a single dispatcher actor / reducer; client-origin events tagged with a nonce to drop broadcasts older than local optimistic mutations, resolving the insert/broadcast race.

nodes.label: AuthenticatedImage Cookie Fetch (C9)
nodes.rationale: /attachments/* requires the session cookie which SwiftUI AsyncImage won't attach; a custom AuthenticatedImage uses URLSession.shared with the app cookie store and caches NSImage via NSCache keyed on storage_path.

nodes.label: Client-Side QR Generation (C8)
nodes.rationale: SwiftUI can't render arbitrary SVG; LOCKED to generate QR client-side via CIQRCodeGenerator from ${APP_URL}/m/card/<id>, saving a server round-trip and matching the server algorithm.

nodes.label: Card Chain Native Graph Decision (§3.7)
nodes.rationale: Web ReactFlow graph has no macOS drop-in; V1 decision prefers a native Canvas force-directed layout hitting /api/cards/:id/chain, with a hosted WKWebView ReactFlow page as documented fallback.

nodes.label: Keychain Token Storage
nodes.rationale: Auth token in Keychain (kSecClassGenericPassword) as backup to URLSession HTTPCookieStorage; never in UserDefaults or .env at runtime. On launch, inject cookie from Keychain if cookie store is empty.

nodes.label: 10-Phase Build Plan (45 days)
nodes.rationale: Vertical-slice phases 0-10: prereqs, foundation, design system, auth, core MVP views (4a-4f), native integrations, preferences, AI+knowledge, polish, testing, ship. Phase 4 dominates; 5/7/8 partly parallelizable.

nodes.label: kanban.npalakurla.com Prod Backend
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted Docker Fastify + Postgres stack on VPS 192.168.50.13; the macOS client targets https://kanban.npalakurla.com.

nodes.label: ANDROID_APP_PLAN (companion)
nodes.rationale: Companion plan built from the same FEATURE_PARITY_REGISTRY for a different platform; referenced but not part of this chunk.

nodes.label: Feature Parity Registry
nodes.rationale: Deep-audit registry (2026-05-21) of 735 features (F-001..F-735) across 42 screens / 43 groups from the ~5,400 LOC web app + ~6,700 LOC server; the authoritative source registry for the macOS and Android plans.

nodes.label: Registry Parity Workflow (status flags)
nodes.rationale: Build agent must implement every F-item for a screen before marking it complete; status transitions ❌→✅ (implemented) / 🔄 (adapted for desktop) / 🚫 (out-of-scope).

nodes.label: Phase 9 Audit Build Status
nodes.rationale: 22 MVP groups code-verified ✅, 5 groups V1-deferred 🔄 (Weather, Activity Ticker, Related Cards, Card Chain, Link Picker), 6 groups 🚫 (Mirror V2, mobile, service worker, server Telegram, backend-only).

nodes.label: I-1 Screen-Locked Screenshot Blocker
nodes.rationale: Visual screenshot diff (Rule 14) is uniformly 🔄 because a locked display blocks Quartz captures from seeing the app surface; fix is a follow-up run with an unlocked display.

nodes.label: Admin Role + Google OAuth + Approval Queue Plan
nodes.rationale: Ships three intertwined capabilities as one milestone across server (Fastify/Postgres), web (React), and macOS (SwiftUI): household-owner admin role, Google OAuth coexisting with email+password, and an admin approval queue for unknown signups. TDD task-by-task with node:test against a real Postgres.
nodes.norm_label: admin role + google oauth + approval queue plan

nodes.label: Additive Admin/OAuth Schema Migration
nodes.rationale: Idempotent additive migration adds users.is_admin + must_change_password and tables user_identities, pending_users, auth_tickets, admin_audit; block appended verbatim to schema.sql for fresh-DB parity.

nodes.label: requireAdmin Prederler + Admin Endpoints
nodes.rationale: routes/admin.ts gated by requireAdmin (403 admin_required) exposes GET /api/admin/users, promote/demote, reset-password, revoke-sessions, GET /api/admin/audit, GET /api/admin/env-admins.

nodes.label: Row-Locked Last-Admin Guard
nodes.rationale: Demote runs in a transaction that FOR UPDATE row-locks every OTHER admin; if zero remain it rolls back with 409 last_admin (or cannot_demote_self_last_admin), preventing an admin-less household.

nodes.label: reconcileEnvAdmin / ADMIN_EMAILS
nodes.rationale: On every login, emails in the ADMIN_EMAILS env list are promoted via a single CTE (UPDATE + audit INSERT, crash-safe); additive-only — removing an email never demotes. Emits an env_promote audit row.

nodes.label: Immutable Admin Audit Log
nodes.rationale: admin_audit is INSERT-only via writeAudit(); actor_id nullable (ON DELETE SET NULL) so rows outlive deleted users. Typed AdminAction enum is the single source of action names; paginated by created_at cursor.

nodes.label: google.ts verifyIdToken / exchangeCode
nodes.rationale: Wraps google-auth-library OAuth2Client: googleEnabled() gate (503 when unset), verifyIdToken with cached JWKS, exchangeCode, buildAuthUrl(openid/email/profile). /api/auth/google/start + /callback routes.

nodes.label: Approval Queue (pending_users)
nodes.rationale: Unknown Google emails land in pending_users; web shows an 'Awaiting approval' page; admins approve/reject; a WS pending_changed broadcast notifies admins; a reaper cleans non-pending rows and expired tickets.

nodes.label: auth_tickets macOS Handoff
nodes.rationale: 60s single-use base64url tickets bind a session token; macOS opens the system browser for OAuth and receives kanbanclaude://auth?ticket=... which /api/auth/ticket/exchange consumes for the session. Reaper deletes expired/consumed.

nodes.label: must_change_password Forced-Change Flow
nodes.rationale: Admin reset-password sets must_change_password + revokes sessions; login/UI auto-redirects to ChangePassword. verifyPassword rejects non-argon2 hashes (OAuth-only users store 'oauth:google').

nodes.label: OAuth Callback Rate Limiting
nodes.rationale: @fastify/rate-limit (new dep) protects /api/auth/google/callback against abuse.
